lessons.title: Understanding Sample Rates & Bit Depth
lessons.content:
# Sample Rates and Bit Depth

Digital audio recording relies on two core principles: **sampling rate** and **bit depth**.

### Key Concepts
* **Sample Rate:** Determines the frequency spectrum (e.g., 44.1kHz vs 48kHz).
* **Bit Depth:** Controls dynamic range (16-bit vs 24-bit vs 32-bit float).

> **Pro Tip:** Always record standard video projects at 48kHz / 24-bit to prevent audio-sync drift in post-production.

quiz.question: Which sample rate is standard for professional broadcast video production?
quiz.explanation: While 44.1 kHz is standard for CD/music distribution, 48.0 kHz is the universal standard across video production and broadcasting.

lessons.title: HDMI vs DisplayPort vs SDI
lessons.content:
# Display Interconnects

Choosing the right transport layer is critical for zero-latency audio-video pipelines.

### Interface Matrix
* **HDMI:** Consumer standard with HDCP encryption and ARC capabilities.
* **DisplayPort:** PC standard optimized for high refresh rates and daisy-chaining.
* **SDI (BNC):** Broadcast standard featuring locking connectors and ultra-long cable runs.
